title: EC-EarthFlow: Probabilistic emulation of daily transient global climate model simulations with flow matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.09715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce EC-EarthFlow, a generative flow matching model that emulates simulations from the physical climate model EC-Earth3. The model is trained on transient simulations from EC-Earth3 (1950-2166, SSP2-4.5) to predict the day ahead temperature field from the previous days temperature as well as annual mean temperature. Predictions are made auto-regressively with rollout periods of between a month and an extended season. Using only this variable of interest, we are able to reproduce the daily variability, spatial patterns, annual cycle and long-term trend from EC-Earth3 at a substantially lower computational cost than the physical model. We demonstrate that EC-EarthFlow is stable for long inference periods, and that it can learn the physical relationships as simulated in EC-Earth3.

translated_title: EC-EarthFlow：基于流匹配的全球气候模型日瞬态模拟的概率性仿真
translated_abstract: 我们提出了EC-EarthFlow，这是一个生成式流匹配模型，用于模拟物理气候模型EC-Earth3的仿真结果。该模型在EC-Earth3的瞬态模拟数据（1950-2166年，SSP2-4.5情景）上进行训练，根据前几天的温度以及年平均温度来预测未来一天的温度场。预测以自回归方式进行，推演周期从一个月到一个延长的季节。仅使用这一感兴趣的变量，我们就能够以远低于物理模型的计算成本再现EC-Earth3的日变率、空间格局、年循环和长期趋势。我们证明EC-EarthFlow在长时间推理过程中保持稳定，并且能够学习到EC-Earth3模拟中所呈现的物理关系。
tldr: EC-EarthFlow是一个生成式流匹配模型，能以远低于物理模型的计算成本稳定地进行自回归模拟，准确再现全球气候模型EC-Earth3日温度场的日变率、空间格局、年循环和长期趋势。
en_tdlr: EC-EarthFlow is a generative flow matching model that stably auto-regressively emulates daily temperature fields from the global climate model EC-Earth3, reproducing its daily variability, spatial patterns, annual cycle, and long-term trend at substantially lower computational cost.
